subject: Emergency exemption request: Infra SRE (REQ-847) to secure QBR capacity
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Emergency exemption request: Infra SRE (REQ-847) to secure QBR capacity

Hi team,

We need an emergency hiring exemption for REQ-847 (Senior Infra SRE) to support the QBR demos and the anticipated production traffic bump in early June. This role is critical to (1) stabilize nightly KV-cache rebuilds that have spiked latency, (2) onboard the new batching pipeline without doubling incident risk, and (3) own our QBR playbook runbook.

Why this is an exception: we are mid-freeze for headcount, but delaying this req by one quarter materially increases the risk to our QBR objectives (OKR: Platform reliability 99.9% across demos; target latency 50ms p50). Ive attached the role profile and a short cost snapshot.

Ask: please confirm path for a freeze-exception (ideally approval for one FTE + one 3-month contractor to accelerate ramp). I can assemble candidate shortlist and a cost-backed ask within 24 hours.

Attachments: role-profile-REQ-847.pdf, budget-snapshot-may2027.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Talent & Ops
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Emergency exemption request: Infra SRE (REQ-847) to secure QBR capacity

Marissa —

Thanks for flagging. Can you summarize the specific OKR deltas if we do nothing this quarter (quantify incidents / hours / customer impact)? Also need a proposed ramp plan (hire vs contract split) and the minimum viable scope for the role so we know what to sign off.

If this is blocking a QBR deliverable that leadership will present, loop in Jonas and I will prioritize the review.

-Soojin
Soojin Lee
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T14:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Emergency exemption request: Infra SRE (REQ-847) to secure QBR capacity

Quick note from finance: well need the headcount gating form completed with the expected monthly burn and any downstream commitment (licenses, tooling). I pulled a budget snapshot (attached) showing constrained runway in the infra bucket for H2.

If you can provide the following we can model the cost impact immediately:
- Annual comp band for the SRE and proposed contractor rate
- Proposed start date and phased spend (FTE vs contractor)
- Expected FY27 incremental run-rate by month

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Finance Planning
Redwood Inference

Attachments: budget-snapshot-may2027.xlsx

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T08:50:00Z
Subject: Re: Emergency exemption request: Infra SRE (REQ-847) to secure QBR capacity

Team,

Per the freeze policy, exceptions require an exec sign-off and completion of the freeze-exception form. Ive started the form and attached the template. If leadership approves, we also need a hiring timeline and a note on internal backfills (if this FTE would be backfilled from another team).

I can fast-track the recruiting loop once the exception form and cost approvals are in. For prioritization at the QBR, please include the specific customer-impact scenarios; that helps the compensation committee decide urgency.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: freeze-exception-form-signed.pdf (draft)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-13T17:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Emergency exemption request: Infra SRE (REQ-847) to secure QBR capacity

On Thu, May 13, 2027 at 16:05 Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marissa — can you summarize the specific OKR deltas if we do nothing this quarter?

Thanks — attached is the completed freeze-exception form (signed by me), a one-page impact memo with numbers, and a candidate shortlist (two internal referrals + one external). Highlights:
- Risk: projected 4x increase in cache-related incidents during QBR demo week; estimated 8 hours of engineer time per incident.
- Customer impact: demo failures risk escalation with two top-tier prospects scheduled for June 8/9.
- Cost: hiring 1 FTE (mid-90s comp band) + 3-month contractor (~$120k total run-rate for contractor months) keeps runway impact to under 0.6% of infra COE for FY27.

Attachments: freeze-exception-form-signed.pdf, candidate-shortlist-REQ847.pdf, cv-ana-gomez.pdf

If approved, I recommend immediate offer to Ana Gomez (internal referral) with parallel contractor start the week of May 24 to buy time for ramp. Ana is already familiar with our KV-cache subsystems.

-M

Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Talent & Ops
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Linda Park <linda@recruitly.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-14T09:00:00Z
Subject: Re: REQ-847 candidate availability (Ana Gomez)

Hi Marissa,

Ana Gomez is available for a fast-track start and can provide two weeks notice. She has SRE experience at scale and is happy to sign an expedited offer. Ibe included a short summary below and can push references immediately.

—Linda
Linda Park
Senior Recruiter, Recruitly
linda@recruitly.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T11:45:00Z
Subject: Approval: Exception granted for REQ-847 (one FTE + one 3-month contractor)

Team — after reviewing the impact memo, budget note from Ben, and Vanessas draft form, I approve an exception for one full-time Senior Infra SRE (REQ-847) plus a 3-month contractor to bridge ramp. Conditions:
1) Offer to Ana Gomez (internal candidate) should include a 6-month performance checkpoint and shadow runbook completion prioritized.
2) Finance to confirm the phased spend schedule before offer acceptance (Ben, please send final monthly run-rate).
3) People to own the backfill signaling plan for Anas current team (Vanessa) and ensure minimal disruption.
4) Recruiting to expedite interviews and extend an offer no later than 2027-05-20.

Jonas — please include a 2-slide note in QBR that mentions mitigation actions taken (this will be needed if asked by the board).

Thanks everyone — move forward on the actions above and mark as "approved-exception" in the freeze tracker.

-Soojin Lee
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
